Title: Trauma endures in Paris suburb after police grenade shatters teenager's jaw
Description: On September 28, 14-year-old Eden suffered a fractured jaw and lost most of his teeth after he was struck in the face by a tear-gas grenade fired at close range, just a few meters from his high school, where a protest was taking place. Students, teachers and parents spoke of their fear, anger and sense of helplessness.

High number of voters makes France's left-wing primary more unpredictable than expected
Description: The first round of the primary is to take place on Friday and Saturday. The 140,000 registered voters, an unexpectedly high number, means the outcome is wide open.

Title: 'Trump dividend': Can promising voters a check help win an election?
Description: Donald Trump is promising $5,000 to every adult US citizen if both chambers remain Republican after the midterm elections on November 3. In his column, Le Monde's Pascal Riché recalls that Silvio Berlusconi and Emmanuel Macron also used financial incentives during their campaigns.

Title: Lutetia wall: 'An archeological discovery can be instantaneous, but knowledge never is'
Description: Following the discovery of a Gallic wall at the Hôtel-Dieu hospital in Paris, archeologist William Van Andringa writes that we cannot make stones speak before we have truly questioned them.

Title: The letter of imprisoned Russian journalist Ivan Safronov: 'Like Jean Valjean, I know what captivity is, and I know how to cherish freedom'
Description: Safronov, a prisoner of conscience who was arrested in 2020 and is now detained in Siberia, turns to literature as a lifeline. He recently reread Victor Hugo's Les Misérables. Here is the letter he sent to Le Monde about this classic.

Title: Heatwaves killed over 8,000 people in France this year. Here are some of their stories
Description: The French health authorities reported that 8,124 deaths were related to the extreme heatwaves between late May and late August in France. Le Monde spoke to the friends and families of 11 of the victims to find out about the lives behind those numbers.

Title: What students are saying during high school blockades: 'I am worried about my future and for all students in France'
Description: From the Paris suburbs to Marseille, as well as Toulouse and Lyon, high schoolers interviewed by Le Monde during the blockades described their study conditions, their concerns and their need to be heard.
